title: Independently validate κ = 0.00302725 and the owned-transpose phase/cost proof
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The new forward owned transpose receives a fresh arbitrary-entry endpoint proof, actual absolute native-phase check, complete literal invoice and changed-word precision/stock/tape applicability proof, followed by independent exact funding. The complete invoice has **64,116 paid / 10,784 productive fields**, rank masses 237,838 / 238,590 and surplus 752. All lost productive targets are debited.

This validates a gain of **.000000575235** over the independently reviewed PR5387 point and **.0000054742** over the frozen selected PR4610/PR5241 baseline. Construction credit remains Ali Romman’s; this contribution supplies independent physical, phase, complete-cost and price-plane verification.

The strict raw crossing enclosure **(.00302728824993,.00302728824994)** is a necessary ceiling for this exact fully charged P/T profile on 0<c<1, with a derivative/remaining-domain proof. It is separate from the funded point and is not an optimum over physical words or compilers. The same five assumptions remain `native_all_columns`, `owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`. No selected record changes.

The mandatory append-only physical scope erratum qualifies historical terminology: all eight reverse-cut dictionaries are nonempty **formal free-group rows**. Independent literal census charges every local/controller occurrence, lost target, scalar/sign/translation and ordinary route. Its conservative route upper is **10,312,000**, including explicit phase groups; local scalar+route upper **10,471,320<20,000,000**, raw complete upper **361,098,496<10^9**. These are constructive allowances, separate from recursive ranks and actual tape runtime. The author’s separately printed 10,292,000 route bound is not substituted for the independent bound.

The directed rational engine checks tested saving `.00302726`, reserve `10^-9`, gap `1/700000000`, compiler `j=44836`, `N=2^31385200000000`, adjacent grid failure, both tails/completion/capacity and **54 strict plus four functional** outer predicates. The package’s registered commands freshly rerun the independent word/phase/control, scalar/grammar, full invoice/chronology and exact funding engines, comparing every stable result field; only runtime and explicitly authenticated historical absolute provenance-path adapters vary. Source inputs and engine copies are read-only in private execution adapters. Actual source-byte, COPY/CLEAR/sign/phase/ownership, unearned-credit and compiler/outer domain mutations reject. The sealed publication package is `702fde7d0a7cde17bc51a9a0bd3a3f740fefc199` (254 files). Its 15,114,240-byte export has SHA256 `a14ea102ef0f7dba610ce4ad43cbebd8d195de01d837d70d6bcf95638b517c8d`.
